Claim amended · 2026-11-03T02:52Z · #29704 file surface named after the premise held

The dev measured the premise at `7b55ea95` (file-surface.md in issue-29704).
- Over the real ListView, a read rejecting 404 `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` renders `data-error-kind=network` and "Check your connection". So the list site is plugin-list's `ListView`, not AppContent ~L2112: in #29673 the meta read answered 200 and the data read 404.
- On the record page (`RecordDetailView`, and `PageView`'s record scope), an answered 5xx reads as a network fault. A 404 there already reads "Record not found".
- The sheet lists every key of a new item, reads `overrides` and English key labels raw in zh-CN, and groups `object_extension` without a translated name.

File surface (replaces the claim's provisional line; stop on breach):
- Sheet: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `preview/changeKeyLabels.ts`, new `views/metadata-admin/schema-field-label.ts` (a leaf, with members moved verbatim), `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (re-exports), and `views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.ts`. Tests: `preview/__tests__/DraftChangesPanel.namedChanges-27835`, `.generatedGroup-25890`, `.protectionEnvelope-12594` and `.groupHeading-13221`.
- Load error: `ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts` (one shared answered-vs-unanswered helper, lifted from RelatedList's `serverSentence` rule), `react/src/index.ts` (its export) and `utils/error-message.test.ts`. Also `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` with new test `src/__tests__/ListView.loadErrorKind.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` (the local rule replaced by the shared helper), `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` with `RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902.test.tsx`, and `app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx` with `__tests__/PageView.appPageRecord-12931.test.tsx`.
- The ten `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs: the `preview.changes.typeCount.object_extension` count family and `preview.changes.detailNewItem`. No key is removed.
- `.changeset/29704-plain-publish-sheet-and-load-errors.md`, with patch bumps for app-shell, react, plugin-list, plugin-detail and i18n.

⛔ Out: the console route's `RouteObjectReadFailed` (`AppContent.tsx`, `MetadataProvider.tsx`, `appObjectScope.ts`). Its defect is by reading, not measured. The fix would carry the error through MetadataProvider's by-name read state, and `appObjectScope.ts` is the landing site of seat 2's #29681 and #29552. The seat files it as a separate card.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — new i18n keys and one new `@object-ui/react` export. The dev runs `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` on the diff, and the seat amends again if its output differs.
Metadata-protocol: none

Serial: `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` is the sheet that seat 1's #29691 edits, on branch `claude/project-thread-pkn482`. Seat 1 edits the props tail, a new export, the destructure and the header. This card edits `TYPE_COUNT`, `EntryDetail`, `KeyRow` and the imports. In the packs, seat 1 adds at `changes.title` and this card at `detailNewKeys`/`typeCount`. The dev merges main right before pr_create.
